From c579d60f0d0cd87552f64fdebe68b5d941d20309 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Hangyu Hua <hbh25y@gmail.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jul 2022 14:23:01 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] ipc: mqueue: fix possible memory leak in init_mqueue_fs()

commit db7cfc380900 ("ipc: Free mq_sysctls if ipc namespace creation
failed")

Here's a similar memory leak to the one fixed by the patch above.
retire_mq_sysctls need to be called when init_mqueue_fs fails after
setup_mq_sysctls.

Fixes: dc55e35f9e81 ("ipc: Store mqueue sysctls in the ipc namespace")
Signed-off-by: Hangyu Hua <hbh25y@gmail.com>
Link: https://lkml.kernel.org/r/20220715062301.19311-1-hbh25y@gmail.com
Signed-off-by: Eric W. Biederman <ebiederm@xmission.com>

diff --git a/ipc/mqueue.c b/ipc/mqueue.c
index 12ad7860bb88..83370fef8879 100644
--- a/ipc/mqueue.c
+++ b/ipc/mqueue.c
@@ -1746,6 +1746,7 @@ static int __init init_mqueue_fs(void)
 	unregister_filesystem(&mqueue_fs_type);
 out_sysctl:
 	kmem_cache_destroy(mqueue_inode_cachep);
+	retire_mq_sysctls(&init_ipc_ns);
 	return error;
 }
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: ipc/mqueue.c**
- A new line was added to the `init_mqueue_fs` function to call `retire_mq_sysctls(&init_ipc_ns);` before returning an error. This change ensures that the system controls for message queues are properly cleaned up in case of a failure during the initialization of the message queue filesystem.

### Relationships
The modification addresses a potential memory leak that could occur if the `init_mqueue_fs` function fails after the `setup_mq_sysctls` function has been called. By adding the call to `retire_mq_sysctls`, the patch ensures that resources allocated for message queue sysctls are released, similar to a previous fix that dealt with a related memory leak issue. This change is part of a broader effort to manage resources effectively within the IPC (Inter-Process Communication) namespace.
